name: @cloudsforge/brand
description: The CloudsForge brand asset set, the runs that produced it, and the harness that compares image models against each other. Images plus a per-provider provenance manifest; the generation engine lives in the sibling studio service and is not duplicated here.
_noDependencies: This package has no dependencies and no node_modules of its own, on purpose.
generate.ts imports four modules from ../studio/src — backend, prompt, specs and sizing — and
the surface registry from ../ui/packages/ui/src/surfaces.ts. All five are dependency-free
TypeScript, so nothing has to be installed to read them; what they encode is every verified
fact about the FLUX 2 Pro endpoint, and a second copy of that in this repository would be a
second place for it to rot. backends.ts adapts them to the provider interface rather than
The consequence is that this repository is NOT self-contained: a run needs the sibling
checkouts beside it. That is the same arrangement the estate's other packages use (link:
rather than file:), and it is the right trade here because the artefacts — the PNGs and the
manifests — are self-contained even though the runner is not.
`pnpm test` is the prompt-parity suite and also runs from ../studio for the same reason. CI
cannot run it (that would need node and tsx installed in a Python-only job, and the workflow
files are owned elsewhere), so the property it guards is ALSO checked from the artefacts by
verify.py, which CI does run: every asset present in two sets must carry the same prompt.
derive.py, verify.py, sheet.py and compare.py need Pillow. Not sips: design-system.md section 7
item 3 names sips as the reason the estate's resize step exists on exactly one laptop.

scripts._generate: Run from the studio workspace so tsx resolves out of its node_modules.
